occurrences.text: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
